def _negamax(depth, ply, alpha, beta, color):
    global NODES, ABORT
    NODES += 1
    if (NODES & 255) == 0 and time.perf_counter() > HARD_DL:
        ABORT = True
    if ABORT:
        return 0
    if color == 1:
        tA = TSET1
        tB = TSET2
        A = CNT1
        B = CNT2
    else:
        tA = TSET2
        tB = TSET1
        A = CNT2
        B = CNT1
    if tA:
        return WINV - 1000 * (ply + 1)
    nb = len(tB)
    if nb >= 2:
        return -(WINV - 1000 * (ply + 2))
    if nb == 1:
        mv = next(iter(tB))
        apply_move(mv, color)
        v = -_negamax(depth, ply + 1, -beta, -alpha, -color)
        undo_move(mv, color)
        return v
    if depth <= 0:
        return SCORE if color == 1 else -SCORE
    moves = [c for c in ORDER if BOARD[c] == 0]
    if not moves:
        return 0
    if depth >= 2:
        keyed = []
        ap = keyed.append
        for c in moves:
            n2 = 0
            for lid in CELL_LINES[c]:
                if A[lid] == 1 and B[lid] == 0:
                    n2 += 1
            ap(-(n2 * 16 + IMP[c]))
        keyed.sort()
        # keyed entries are (score, c)
        moves = [t[1] for t in keyed]
    best = -INF
    for mv in moves:
        apply_move(mv, color)
        v = -_negamax(depth - 1, ply + 1, -beta, -alpha, -color)
        undo_move(mv, color)
        if ABORT:
            return 0
        if v > best:
            best = v
            if v > alpha:
                alpha = v
                if alpha >= beta:
                    break
    return best

def _negamax(depth, ply, alpha, beta, color,
             BOARD=BOARD, CNT1=CNT1, CNT2=CNT2,
             TSET1=TSET1, TSET2=TSET2,

        return 0
    if color == 1:
        tA = TSET1
        tB = TSET2
        A = CNT1
        B = CNT2
    else:
        tA = TSET2
        tB = TSET1
        A = CNT2
        B = CNT1
    if tA:
        return WINV - 1000 * (ply + 1)
    nb = len(tB)
    if nb >= 2:
        return -(WINV - 1000 * (ply + 2))
    if nb == 1:
        mv = next(iter(tB))
        apply_move(mv, color)
        v = -_negamax(depth, ply + 1, -beta, -alpha, -color)
        undo_move(mv, color)
        return v
    if depth <= 0:
        return SCORE if color == 1 else -SCORE
    moves = [c for c in ORDER if BOARD[c] == 0]
    if not moves:
        return 0
    if depth >= 2:
        keyed = []
        kap = keyed.append
        for c in moves:
            n2 = 0
            for lid in CELL_LINES[c]:
                if A[lid] == 1 and B[lid] == 0:
                    n2 += 1
            kap((-(n2 * 16 + IMP[c]), c))
        keyed.sort()
        moves = [t[1] for t in keyed]
    best = -INF
    for mv in moves:
        apply_move(mv, color)
        v = -_negamax(depth - 1, ply + 1, -beta, -alpha, -color)
        undo_move(mv, color)
        if ABORT:
            return 0
        if v > best:
            best = v
            if v > alpha:
                alpha = v
                if alpha >= beta:
                    break
    return best
